summary: Spectrum 2 is an open source instant messaging transport designed to bridge different communication networks together. It allows users on separate chat services to interact within a unified environment. The software is written in C++ and released under the GPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: It is suited for administrators looking to connect disparate instant messaging protocols into a single communication infrastructure.
watchOut: The project exhibits low maintenance activity, suggesting you may need to patch bugs or handle compatibility issues yourself.
deployNotes: As a C++ application, you will typically need to compile the source or manage native packages, alongside setting up standard persistent storage and a reverse proxy for network traffic.
